name: agent-ide
description: Agent IDE coding-companion skill: find a symbol address, read the symbol, replace it or edit lines inside it, with the ide.start/diff/inspect/stop/edit/outline/read/symbol/test tools.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded ide.* workflow for active-session source edits
interface.longDescription: Loads the agent-ide skill so a coder subagent works by symbol address with the nine ide.* tools (start, diff, inspect, stop, edit, outline, read, symbol, test) when the Agent IDE MCP tools are active, with fail-open native fallback when they are not.
